comments.author: asciimov
comments.story_title: The Nimatron: first 'video game' debuted in 1939
comments.why_zh: 固定式机械计算机的例子，程序存储在齿轮中。
comments.text_zh: 这些年来，我们把 computer 这个词的含义从“进行计算或推算的东西”演化成了“运行软件的电子设备”。实际上，任何输入与输出之间具有一一对应关系的黑盒都可以被视为计算机。也许更容易理解的是机械计算机，比如二战时海军舰艇上的火控计算机[0]，或者更有名的安提基特拉机械[1]。这些是固定装置，它们根据输入计算数值。“程序”存储在齿轮、凸轮轴、差速器以及它们之间的传动比之中。类似地，像 Nimatron 这样的固定数字计算机把其运算存储在继电器和数字逻辑中。这类计算机没有指令列表。它们只有原理图，输入经过电子电路，最终得到输出。只用简单的逻辑门就能完成大量计算。[0] - [VIDEO] [1] - [LINK]
comments.text: Over the years we have evolved the meaning of computer from something that calculates or reckons to a electronic device that runs software. In reality any black box that has a one-to-one relationship between inputs and outputs can be considered a computer. It might be easier to think of mechanical computers, such as the WW2 fire control computers aboard Navy Ships[0] or more famously the Antikythera mechanism[1]. These are fixed devices, they compute values from inputs. The "program" is stored in the gears camshafts and differentials and ratios between them. Similarly, fixed digital computers such as the Nimatron have their operations stored in relays and digital logic. These sorts of computers don't have a list of instructions. They just have schematics, inputs going through electronic circuits that wind up at outputs. You can do a lot of calculating with just simple logic gates. [0] - [VIDEO] [1] - [LINK]

comments.author: ants_everywhere
comments.story_title: Is life a form of computation?
comments.why_zh: 模拟计算机不通过符号运算的经典例子。
comments.quote_zh: 关于火控计算机的经典视频
comments.text_zh: 模拟计算机通常不是通过对符号进行运算来计算的。例如，看看关于火控计算机的经典视频 [VIDEO]。OP 的具体说法是它们“将符号映射为符号”。模拟计算机不这么做。有些可以，但这不是它们的定义。Turing machines 等是数学中的一种计算模型。人类通过操作符号来做数学，所以那个模型才操作符号。这并不是定义中固有的部分。
comments.text: analog computers don't generally compute by operating on symbols. For example see the classic video on fire control computers [VIDEO] OP's specific phrasing is that they "map symbols to symbols". Analog computers don't do that. Some can, but that's not their definition. Turing machines et al. are a model of computation in mathematics. Humans do math by operating on symbols, so that's why that model operates on symbols. It's not an inherent part of the definition.

comments.author: lmm
comments.story_title: Is life a form of computation?
comments.why_zh: 在关于符号计算的争论中被引用为例子。
comments.text_zh: > 模拟计算机通常不是通过对符号进行运算来计算的。例如，看看关于火控计算机的经典视频 [VIDEO] > OP 的具体说法是它们“将符号映射为符号”。模拟计算机不这么做。有些可以，但这不是它们的定义。 那怎么就不是符号性的了？从根本上说，那类计算机把一些杆或齿轮之类的位置映射到另一些杆或齿轮之类的位置，而第一组杆或齿轮是在象征运动或仰角之类的东西，最后一组则是在象征炮管角度之类的东西。（当然，你可以在物理上把最后的齿轮直接连到真正的炮管上，但那不是计算的部分；计算是中间那些小齿轮和杆在做的部分，而它们具有符号意义）。
comments.text: > analog computers don't generally compute by operating on symbols. For example see the classic video on fire control computers [VIDEO] > OP's specific phrasing is that they "map symbols to symbols". Analog computers don't do that. Some can, but that's not their definition. How is that not symbolic? Fundamentally that kind of computer maps the positions of some rods or gears or what have you to the positions of some other rods or gears or what have you, and the first rods or gears are symbolising motion or elevation or what have you and the final one is symbolising barrel angle or what have you. (And sure, you might physically connect the final gear directly to the actual gun barrel, but that's not the part that's computation; the computation is the part happening with the little gears and rods in the middle, and they have symbolic meanings).
